scenes.name: 01_beetle_model
scenes.title: A genome becomes movement
scenes.educational_message: A genome is a sequence of turn commands that produces a trajectory.

scenes.name: 02_population
scenes.title: Different genomes explore different paths
scenes.educational_message: Different genomes produce different trajectories under identical physics.

scenes.name: 03_evaluation_selection
scenes.title: Evaluate, then select parents
scenes.educational_message: Better evaluated candidates are more likely to become parents.

scenes.name: 04_crossover_mutation
scenes.title: Crossover combines programs; mutation changes commands
scenes.educational_message: Offspring combine parent command sequences and receive small random changes.

scenes.name: 05_one_generation_transition
scenes.title: One generation update, step by step
scenes.educational_message: One update evaluates a population, selects parents, creates offspring, and evaluates the next generation.

scenes.name: 06_simple_evolution
scenes.title: Repeated generations improve the search
scenes.educational_message: Repeating evaluation and variation can gradually improve the population.

scenes.name: 07_two_bridges_evolution
scenes.title: A population can explore different route families
scenes.educational_message: A richer map permits qualitatively different useful routes.

scenes.name: 08_method_comparison
scenes.title: Three search strategies, one shared problem
scenes.educational_message: GA, random search, and local search explore the same problem differently.

scenes.name: 09_spiral_fitness_problem
scenes.title: When closer to the goal is not better
scenes.educational_message: Straight-line distance can reward an unreachable approach through a wall.
